WAS.week10_result: W 24-21 at NYG (Thu Nov 12, TNF, MetLife Stadium). Commanders now 3-5-1. Jayden Daniels 23/33, 249 yds, 3 TD, 2 INT (both late in the 4th), 11 rushes for 28; Stefon Diggs caught the 32-yard game-winning TD with under a minute left (6-83-1). Defense sealed it with an interception. No in-game injuries found in coverage.

qb.notes: Schedule-file projection confirmed. Mariota is back from an early-season sprained MCL and was the active No. 2 on Nov 12; rookie Athan Kaliakmanis was the inactive emergency third QB. First Week 11 practice report due Thu Nov 19.
